text: Uros, Amantani, Taquile, and Isla del Sol are a few islands located in this body of water, and the Taraco and Yampupata Peninsula protrude into this body of water. This body of water is fed by the Ilave, Coata, and Ramis Rivers among others, and it empties into the Desaguadero River. Divided into two parts by the Strait of Tiquina, it has the highest elevation of any major lake in the world. Located on the border of Peru and Bolivia is, for 10 points, what second largest lake by area and largest by volume in South America?
